title: People across Varginha report seeing spaceships

tellings.quote: Yes. If you walk throughout the city, there are always reports of people who have seen spaceships.

plain: People all over the Brazilian city of Varginha say they have seen spaceships, according to Ahmed Foratu, a guest who speaks as a witness on an episode about a hospital said to have operated on an alien. "If you walk throughout the city," he tells Michels, "there are always reports of people who have seen spaceships." He passes this on as what he has heard from people around town, and if it is true, sightings there are an ordinary part of local life rather than a single event.
